family: T-slot hardware for 20 x 20 slot-6 extrusion (Misumi HFS5 series): slot section, post-assembly insertion (drop-in) nuts HNTAJ5 M3 / M5
title: MISUMI USA 2019 catalogue, pages 2716-2717 (post-assembly insertion nuts for HFS5 series) and 2686-2687 (HFS5 series extrusions, 'Slot Details (Common to All Series)')
state: slot section: read from the maker's dimensioned catalogue drawing. T-nut: re-made from the maker's dimensioned catalogue drawing (all six dimensions used; two drawn but un-dimensioned features left out). Supplier CAD still wanted (Misumi's CAD needs a login).
wanted: Misumi's STEP of HNTAJ5-5 and HNTAJ5-3, saved as vendor_cad/inbox/TNUT-2020-M5.step and TNUT-2020-M3.step

used.centre_groove: 120 degree V, 0.3 mm deep ('Slot Bottom Details', HFS and CAF series)
used.source: MISUMI USA 2019 catalogue (us.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2019/) p.2686, 'Slot Details (Common to All Series)': 6 (opening), 2 (lip), 4 (lip underside to slot floor), 12 (T slot width); 'Slot Bottom Details': 120 degrees, 0.3. The HFS5-2020 section on the same page: 20 square, 4-R1, centre hole 4.2. The community DXF in vendor_docs/ agrees with every one of these
used.status: READ from the maker's catalogue drawing (fetched 2026-11-19, copy in vendor_docs/). No tolerances are given on the drawing

alternative.profile: 20 x 20 B-type slot 6 (Bosch-compatible), as drawn in the community STEP that is the extrusion's display model
alternative.source: vendor_cad/profile_2020_slot6.step (FreeCAD-library Profile-20x20-B-Type_Slot6_A.step), measured by point-in-solid probing 2026-11-18: lip underside 1.495 mm below the face, floor 5.30 mm below the face from 1 to 3 mm off the centre line, 5.70 mm on the centre line
alternative.status: ASSUMED: a community file of another make of 2020 slot-6 profile (B-type); kept to show what a shallower slot would do

secondary.claim: 20x20 B-type slot 6: groove width 6 mm, groove depth 5.5 mm
secondary.source: web-search snippet of motedis.es 'Profile 20x20 B type slot 6'
web-search snippet of a 2020 profile datasheet hosted on fab.academany.org

slot.simulation_solid: extrusion_2020's simulation solid has plain rectangular slots 6.2 mm wide and 5.0 mm deep, with no T cavity and no lips: shallower than both drawings (6.0 / 5.3 mm) and without the 2.0 / 1.5 mm lip

tnut.part: Misumi HNTAJ5-3 / HNTAJ5-5 (PACK-HNTAJ5-*: 100 per pack), 'Post-Assembly Insertion Short Nuts' for HFS5 series; body 1010 carbon steel, trivalent chromate; wing part (leaf spring that holds it in the slot) 304 stainless
tnut.type: drop-in (post-assembly insertion: goes into the slot through the opening anywhere along the extrusion; a leaf spring holds its position)
tnut.source: MISUMI USA 2019 catalogue (us.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2019/) p.2717, drawing of HNTAJ5: 10 (length), 8 (width), 3.2 (overall height), 2.4 (height of the wide body), 5.8 (width of the neck), M (thread, through). Part number table: M = 3, 4, 5

body_height_mm.status: drawing: the 8 mm wide part that sits under the slot's lips

neck_width_mm.status: drawing: the part that stands in the 6 mm slot opening

thread_length_mm.status: drawing: the thread is shown through the whole height (hidden lines through body and neck)

reference_tightening_torque_nm.status: catalogue table beside the HFS5 post-assembly nuts on the same pages (1010 carbon steel, M5: 6.8 N.m); no figure is given for M3

left_out_of_the_model: the chamfers on the body's four long edges (drawn, no dimension)
the countersink ring round the hole in the plan view (drawn, no dimension)
tnut.read_by_us: that the nut seats with its 8 mm body against the underside of the lips and its neck up in the opening is our reading of the catalogue's application sketch; the drawing does not say it in words
tnut.m3_body: the catalogue gives one drawing for M3, M4 and M5: same body

engagement_rule.full: the screw passes the nut's whole thread, or has 0.8 d of thread in it: no finding
engagement_rule.reduced: 0.5 d to 0.8 d without using the nut's whole thread: warning, grouped
engagement_rule.status: DERIVED by us from standard nut heights (ISO 4035 thin nut about 0.5 d, recalled; ISO 4032 0.8 d). The maker rates the M5 nut at 6.8 N.m with its own 3.2 mm (0.64 d) of thread, which is why a screw through the whole nut raises no finding

bottoming_margin_mm.status: DERIVED: ISO 4762 length tolerance js15 (+/-0.29 mm to 10 mm, +/-0.35 to 18 mm; recalled) plus about 0.1 mm each for washer and sheet thickness

geometries._about: Slot + T-nut geometries the T-slot screw check judges every screw against. 'used' decides errors: the slot from slot.used and the drawn T-nut part's own dimensions. Each entry of 'alternatives' is reported with the screws that would fail on it. Depths are from the extrusion's outer face, mm; thread_start is where the nut's thread begins with the nut seated under the lips.

alternatives.name: 2020 slot 6, B-type (community STEP) + Misumi HNTAJ5 nut
alternatives.status: ASSUMED: slot from vendor_cad/profile_2020_slot6.step (community drawing of another make of 2020 slot-6 profile); the nut as Misumi draws it

geometries.not_used: McMaster's 20 mm rail 5537T101 (5 mm slot) with T-nuts 5278N42 / 5278N44: owner decision 2026-11-19, the frame is standard 2020 with the 6 mm slot. Their measurements are in vendor_cad/staging/supplier_2026-11-18/MANIFEST.md and are not judged here.

decision: Owner, 2026-11-19: the frame is the common 2020 profile with the 6 mm slot (Misumi HFS5-2020 class). McMaster's 20 mm rail with a 5 mm slot, its T-nuts and its bracket are not used; their files stay in vendor_cad/staging/supplier_2026-11-18/_DEVIATIONS/.
